LEADER: Brian Niccol, former Chairman and CEO, left in August 2024; Scott Boatwright is CEO. HOLDERS: Vanguard's 11.25% rests on a Schedule 13G/A filed January 7, 2026 (no as-of date given, so asOf is the filing date); the proxy adds that a later Vanguard 13G/A (March 26, 2026) reported zero shares as of January 12, 2026 after an internal reorganization disaggregated its holdings, with its subsidiaries reporting separately, so the 11.25% is the last aggregate figure, not current. Capital World Investors' 7.92% is as of December 31, 2025. BlackRock no longer appears in the 5% table. GEOGRAPHY: Chipotle reports one reportable segment (U.S.); the other operating segments (Canada, Europe, international partner-operated restaurants) are shown as 'All other revenue' in the reconciliation.
